title: EC60042: Rf And Microwave Integrated Circuits
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisites: EC31005RF/ Microwave Passive Components: Lumped Elements:
Equivalent circuits. RF Integrated Circuits : Lumped element approach. RFIC
Simulation tools. Linear amplifier design. Effect of parasitics. Planar
Transmission Lines, Designing with Scattering Parameters, transistor
amplifiers, oscillators and mixers. Microwave Integrated Circuits and VLSI
Interconects. RF and Microwave Passive and Active Labs (VNAs etc.).
